user.title: Connect to ASUSTOR NAS
user.description: Enable SNMP in ADM first. For the confirmed ADM configuration, select version 3, authNoPriv and MD5. Passphrases must be at least eight characters. On reconfiguration, leave a secret blank to retain its current value.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot communicate with the NAS. Check the host, UDP port 161, routing and SNMP settings.
error.invalid_auth: The NAS rejected the credentials or security level. Check username, passphrases, authentication and privacy protocols.
error.not_asustor: The host did not expose an ASUSTOR serial number and model. Check the SNMP view and host.
error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address without a URL, path or port.
error.invalid_config: Check name, username and required passphrases (minimum eight characters). SNMP text fields must use Latin-1 characters; usernames and context names may contain at most 32 bytes.

abort.wrong_device: The serial number does not match the configured NAS.

init.title: Monitoring options
init.description: Storage defaults to GiB and memory to MiB, consistent with the supplied NAS readings. The vendor MIB is ambiguous about these units. Enable UPS monitoring only when a UPS is connected; unidentified UPS rows are ignored.
